name: People and Contacts
description: Business domain covering the people and organizations Adventure Works deals with, and how to reach them: persons, business entities, addresses, email addresses, phone numbers and geographic locations. Employees, customers and vendors all draw on these shared concepts.

name: Person
description: A human being involved with Adventure Works: an employee, a customer or a contact at a vendor or store. Person information includes name, title and additional contact information.

name: Business Entity
description: The common identity that connects vendors, customers and employees with their address and contact information.

name: Business Contact
description: A person who acts as a contact for a store, vendor or employee, together with the type of contact they are, such as a purchasing agent or owner.

name: Address
description: Street address information for customers, employees and vendors. An address is linked to a business entity with a type of address, such as billing, shipping or home.

name: Email Address
description: Where to send a person email.

name: Phone Number
description: The telephone number and type of phone (such as cell, home or work) of a person.

name: Person Credential
description: One-way hashed authentication information for a person. The credential is sensitive: it is recorded here as a concept, and its values should never be exposed.

name: Country or Region
description: A country or region identified by its ISO standard code.

name: State or Province
description: A state or province within a country or region, assigned to a sales territory.
